category_title: Students who use avoidance strategies like pretended reading during silent reading
scenario_title: Silent reading session with avoidance behaviors
minimal_context: The student is expected to read independently and quietly from a book during a silent reading session after the lunch break.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: It is time for our silent reading session. Please open your books and read independently and quietly.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Whispers in a low voice to a classmate in the corner and keeps turning the pages without stopping to read.)

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Please make sure you are looking at your book.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Swaps books with the classmate, opening a text that has many words and no illustrations.)

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Are you reading your new book now?

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: I'm just going to kind of fake read it. Like, look at the words but don't actually read it.

dialogue_combined:
TUTOR: It is time for our silent reading session. Please open your books and read independently and quietly.

STUDENT: (Whispers in a low voice to a classmate in the corner and keeps turning the pages without stopping to read.)

TUTOR: Please make sure you are looking at your book.

STUDENT: (Swaps books with the classmate, opening a text that has many words and no illustrations.)

TUTOR: Are you reading your new book now?

STUDENT: I'm just going to kind of fake read it. Like, look at the words but don't actually read it.

context.materials: Books, including those with too many words and no humor/illustrations
context.social_setting: Whole class silent reading session, teacher at desk looking through folders
context.time_context: Approximately 15 to 20 minutes, 4 days a week

challenging_behavior_trigger.condition: When forced to read books with too many words and no humor/illustrations
challenging_behavior_trigger.observable_behavior: Look at the words but don't actually read it; fake read it
related_quotes: Then I would kind of fake read it. Like, look at the words but don ’t actually read it.

behavior_patterns.condition: When expected to read independently and quietly while teacher monitors from desk
behavior_patterns.observable_behavior: Most of the students were not reading; several kept turning pages; two students had swapped their books twice; four students seated in at the corner continued to whisper in a low voice
